output.summary: Reported on-time gains coincide with the bonus start (Mar 2026, Pell Junction Jul), not RouteWise: revisions jumped about 5x at each center when its bonus began, mostly Operational-Capacity, late-entered, rarely notified. RouteWise went live at Riverside and Pell Junction in Feb, and Northgate only in Oct, yet Northgate's gain began in March. Brightwell's records show 81% on time against original dates (87% a year earlier) while the scorecard says 98.4%, and lateness complaints are up 35%. The campaign and a higher bonus would be harmful. Recomputing against original dates and auditing the revisions is the best next step. The driver shortage is plausible but unadjusted, so the $2.1M hiring plan is premature. Substantive fixes beyond measurement lack recomputed data.
